title: Human-in-the-Loop Hate Speech Classification in a Multilingual Context

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance degradation through cross-dataset and cross-platform experiments (e.g., training on online news comments and testing on Twitter data) to measure how the model overfits to specific data sources.

Comparing the classification performance (F1 scores) of monolingual versus multilingual BERT models across Swiss German and French datasets to identify biases propagating from pre-training data and language representation in the corpus.

Testing the classifier's performance across different chronological cut-offs (with training and testing sets separated by up to 6 months) to measure model performance decay and shifting language usage over time.

Quantifying the natural data imbalance and distribution of hate speech targets across 10 specific categories (Nationality, Politics, Sex, Social Status, Religion, Age, Gender, Impairments, Appearance, and Other) to assess representation disparities within the training corpus.
